title: Cognitive Ease
coreMove: discount the extra credibility that comes only from a claim feeling easy to process
sourcePressure: shows how fluency, familiarity, and ease make claims feel truer and safer than they deserve
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: equating ease with comfort or relaxation instead of truth-feeling

hook: opening with a named bias definition for Cognitive Ease
starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar
counterintuition: the obvious advice is simply slow down
smart people are immune if they know the term
tryThisNow: write three lessons in a journal
examples: student in a classroom guessing an answer
